new_categories.label: fire_detection_function_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-area fire-detection function readiness is a protective service-state distinct from gas/vapor atmosphere monitoring and from cargo-transfer machinery readiness.

new_categories.label: detection_coverage_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Fire-detection coverage can be represented as bounded scope confidence without retaining detector type, count, placement or alarm threshold.

new_categories.label: fixed_suppression_system_readiness
new_categories.memory: Fixed fire-suppression system readiness is distinct from detection readiness and from downstream operational release confidence.

new_categories.label: suppression_supply_support_confidence
new_categories.memory: Availability of the suppression medium/supply support domain can degrade separately from the protected-space hardware state without retaining agent type or quantity.

new_categories.label: activation_interface_readiness
new_categories.memory: A non-operational activation/release-interface readiness state can be separated from suppression-system physical readiness without retaining release logic, sequence or instructions.

new_categories.label: compartment_scope_localization
new_categories.memory: Detection or suppression assurance can be localized to an affected cargo-area or compartment scope rather than generalized to all vessel spaces.

new_categories.label: monitoring_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring/indication confidence is distinct from the physical detection and suppression states and can degrade independently.

new_categories.label: detection_suppression_independence_confidence
new_categories.memory: Detection assurance and suppression assurance should remain separately attributable even when they contribute to one broader fire-protection confidence state.

new_categories.label: support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, control, supply or other support-dependency confidence should remain separate from detection, suppression and indication readiness.

new_categories.label: fire_protection_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to detection, coverage, suppression, supply/support, activation interface, monitoring or compartment scope.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-operation restriction, safety-assurance concern, terminal incompatibility, rework or schedule effects do not prove a detector, suppression-system, support or compartment-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_fire_protection_restoration
new_categories.memory: Physical correction, support recovery, detection verification, suppression verification, monitoring return and operational release may occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: gas_vapor_detection_vs_fire_detection
useful_refinements.memory: P105 atmosphere monitoring and gas/vapor detection refines generic sensor semantics but does not duplicate dedicated fire-detection readiness or coverage.

useful_refinements.label: containment_vs_fire_suppression_assurance
useful_refinements.memory: P104 spill containment/drainage condition is a separate protective layer and cannot substitute for fixed fire-suppression readiness.

useful_refinements.label: shutdown_link_vs_fire_protection
useful_refinements.memory: P101 ship/shore emergency-shutdown link assurance is distinct from onboard fire detection/suppression protection and its compartment scope.

useful_refinements.label: generic_control_vs_physical_suppression_readiness
useful_refinements.memory: P068-style control/monitoring availability does not establish physical suppression-system or supply-support readiness.

duplicates.label: generic_protective_system_support_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic protective-system support, degradation and restoration mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_verification_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope-localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics are already campaign-wide.

exact testing, release, firefighting, troubleshooting or emergency-response methods
named fire-protection providers, terminals, inspectors, incidents or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact cargo-area fire detector types, counts, locations, suppression agents, quantities, release logic, alarm thresholds, control settings, test values and current configuration
exact testing, release, firefighting, troubleshooting, evacuation or emergency-response procedures
named fire-detection/fixed-suppression providers, terminals, inspectors, incidents, deficiency findings and current readiness
private/regional fire-protection equipment/service lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact detector, agent, quantity, release logic, alarm threshold, testing, emergency procedure, provider or incident detail that is deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive cargo-area fire detection/fixed-suppression service-state orientation/source-discovery output; not release, firefighting, evacuation or emergency-response guidance and not proof of any exact detector, suppression agent, quantity, alarm threshold, release logic, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
